WITH acct_grp AS (
  SELECT t.account_id AS account_id,
         a.frequency AS frequency,
         AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                  WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount
                  ELSE NULL END) AS grp_avg
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency
),
freq_grp AS (
  SELECT frequency, AVG(grp_avg) AS freq_avg
  FROM acct_grp
  GROUP BY frequency
)
SELECT g.account_id,
       g.frequency,
       g.grp_avg,
       g.grp_avg / f.freq_avg AS quotient
FROM acct_grp g
JOIN freq_grp f ON f.frequency = g.frequency
ORDER BY (g.grp_avg / f.freq_avg IS NULL), g.grp_avg / f.freq_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
